constraints: BC config seed only; restore exact seed101 bytes
one Kit;3GiB RAM guard;owned PIDs only
same stock matching;no yaw fold;D3scope6 flags unchanged
second and final new experiment; no H6 without new user approval
all original ten open target positions preserved; no repeated stationary hold added

definitions.close: action last<0 and previous>=0; before first sample open
definitions.policy_near_secured: Unchanged claude_recovery_metrics.py trial near_closes and claude_transport_slip.py secured_rows first-secured criteria; no successful-only selection
definitions.precision: Actual truck-frame EEF position at first close, XY norm mm and z mm; wrist/truck x-axis heading absolute error modulo180 degrees
definitions.preclose_speed: Per-episode mean norm(diff(actual obs/eef_pos[k-10:k],axis=0)) / .05, 9 differences; cohort median; k first close onset
definitions.quality: full episode dt.05 skip0 per-episode p95 then cohort median, no per-episode rejection

factor.name: pregrasp_time_dilation
factor.profile: After stock source selection and transform, in agibot/subtask0/toy_truck only, identify first negative-gripper waypoint. Insert one shortest-rotation SE(3) midpoint between each adjacent pair among the immediately preceding ten open-gripper waypoints. Preserve all original poses/fields/order, all subsequent close/lift/place and other subtasks. Clone only; no stationary hold, no yaw fold, Z offset zero. Fail if ten preceding open waypoints absent.

mechanism.M1: Generated preclose10 mean EEF speed cohort median <=75% E2; generated close height within2mm, XY median<=E2+2mm and heading median<=E2+2deg; original waypoint geometry/order invariant and exactly9 midpoint insertions verified
mechanism.M2: All first-near-close policy truck-frame XY error median <=E2 median-3mm; no-near separately counted, not success-conditioned
mechanism.M3: First-secured/all-first-near-close proportion >78/167 with one-sided pooled two-proportion z p<.05; report first-secured absolute count and no-near fraction

performance_selection.multiple_attempts: Bonferroni budget for at most2 new experiments; each alpha.025
performance_selection.test: unpaired pooled two-proportion z; scipy norm.sf; no continuity correction

verdict.generation_gate_failure: H5 feasibility failure; preserve outputs, no tuning/retry with different factor or relaxed gate; no third experiment
verdict.inconclusive: all other outcomes; unavailable measures flagged separately, not auto-rejected alone
verdict.rejected: pooled successes<=40 OR available M1/M2 fails OR available first-secured/near<=78/167
verdict.supported: P AND M1 AND M2 AND M3
